sinopsis.es: Con miles de siluetas animadas cuadro a cuadro, la historia sigue a un príncipe árabe y su caballo volador, entre hechizos inspirados en Las mil y una noches.
sinopsis.en: Mobilizing thousands of stop-motion animated silhouettes with inventive technical mastery, the story follows an Arab prince and his flying horse, amidst sorceries inspired by One Thousand and One Nights. In this centennial animation milestone and first feature film of its kind directed by a woman, the impersonality of the cutout figures gives way to the human character of their gestures. A work that echoes the hallmark of expressionism and avant-garde movements, complexly evoking the idea of alterity by incorporating the racial and gender tensions of the European interwar period. (C.I.)
